title: Receipt
description: Information needed for labelling images for this project's OCR tasks
_comment: TransacOCR receipt test schema. Model output shape and hand-labeled ground-truth shape. Account numbers stored masked (last four digits only).
image_file: string (filename of the receipt image, e.g. gcash_0001.png)
provider: string | null (GCash, Maya, BDO, BPI, MariBank, GoTyme, Wise, other)
status: string | null (successful, pending, failed). Only successful transactions are scored as transactions.
transaction_type: string | null (send money, cash in, cash out, bill payment, QR payment, remittance, other)

fee.value: number | null (service charge, if printed; 0 if shown as free)

total.value: number | null (amount plus fee, if printed)

reference_number.value: string | null (alphanumeric, no spaces or hyphens)

account.value: string | null (masked, last four digits only, e.g. "****1182")
string | null (masked, last four digits only, e.g. "****4417")

merchant.name: string | null (biller or business, e.g. Meralco, Globe Postpaid). Null for person-to-person transfers.
merchant.category: string | null (bill payment, QR payment, online purchase, other)
